title: The Share Taken on a Granite Ridge Carry-Forward Election According to When It Is Recorded
content:
| How far the election period has run when the election is recorded | Share taken of the figure carried into that step |
| --- | --- |
| before a third of the period, counted from the day the pass became scannable, has run | three quarters, a share of 75 per cent |
| after a third but before two thirds of that period has run | nine tenths, a share of 90 per cent |
| any later position | not reduced by this rule |

The schedule above governs the share taken at that step of a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme carry-forward fee. Where the election is recorded before a third of the election period counted from the day the pass became scannable has run, three quarters of that figure is taken. Where it is recorded after a third but before two thirds of that period has run, nine tenths of that figure is taken. In any other case the share taken is not reduced by this rule.

Note 1. The period is the tier's own election period, counted in days from the day the pass became scannable.

Note 2. On a Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass, whose election period is 30 days, a third of it has run once 10 days have passed and two thirds once 20 days have passed: at 9 days the share is 75 per cent, at 10 days it is 90 per cent, at 19 days it is 90 per cent, and at 20 days the share is not reduced by this rule.

Note 3. On a Granite Ridge Local Pass, whose election period is 21 days, a third has run once 7 days have passed and two thirds once 14 days have passed: an election recorded 6 days after the pass became scannable is taken at 75 per cent, one recorded on the 7th day at 90 per cent, and one recorded on the 14th day is not reduced by this rule.

Note 4, worked on hypothetical figures. A Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass became scannable on 1 December and carries an election period of 30 days. An election recorded on 6 December stands 5 days after the pass became scannable, below the third of the period that has run at 10 days, so three quarters of the figure is taken: on a figure of 149.00 that gives 111.75.
